definitions.explanation: A person whose job is to deliver packages, food, mail, or other items to homes and businesses.

examples.japanese: {配達員|はいたついん}が{荷物|にもつ}を{届|とど}けてくれた。
examples.english: The delivery person brought the package.

examples.japanese: フードデリバリーの{配達員|はいたついん}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I'm working as a food delivery courier.

examples.japanese: {配達員|はいたついん}が{来|く}る{前|まえ}に、{受|う}け{取|と}り{場所|ばしょ}を{確認|かくにん}しておいてください。
examples.english: Please confirm the pickup location before the delivery person arrives.

notes:
Compound of {配達|はいたつ} (delivery) + {員|いん} (member, worker). A common term that has become increasingly frequent with the growth of online shopping and food delivery services.

USAGE:
Used for all types of delivery workers — package couriers, mail carriers, newspaper deliverers, and food delivery riders. With the rise of services like Uber Eats and {出前館|でまえかん}, the word has become even more common in daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配達員|はいたついん}が{届|とど}ける — a delivery person delivers
- {配達員|はいたついん}を{呼|よ}ぶ — to call a delivery person
- {宅配|たくはい}{配達員|はいたついん} — home delivery courier
- フードデリバリー{配達員|はいたついん} — food delivery worker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {配達人|はいたつにん} — delivery person (slightly more old-fashioned variant)
- {宅配便|たくはいびん}ドライバー — parcel delivery driver
- {郵便配達|ゆうびんはいたつ} — mail delivery (the service, not the person)
